about: mistudio.probe-identity/1: the detector and decision digests of a mistudio.probe-definition/v1 document. Each digest is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) form of the wrapper {"algorithm": <algorithm>, "digest": "detector" | "decision", "payload": <projection>}. The detector projection is computed over the parsed JSON document and the decision projection over its `decision` block, each by `projection`: only the listed keys, every listed key present, an absent key written as its `projection.defaults` value (null when not listed), nested objects projected the same way. Paths use `.` between keys, `[]` for each element of a list and `{}` for each value of a map. So absent, null (for keys whose default is null) and the declared default hash equal, and -0.0 and 0.0 hash equal (RFC 8785 writes both as 0). Numbers are written as ECMAScript Number::toString writes them; `numbers` lists IEEE-754 doubles (big-endian `bits`) with their exact RFC 8785 text. Each case is a complete valid document with its expected canonical texts and digests; `relation` states whether it shares the detector and decision digests of another case. To reproduce: parse `document`, project, canonicalise, hash, compare. A digest gives integrity, not authenticity: it proves a document agrees with itself, not who produced it. decision_revision is not hashed. No case carries behaviour data.
